title: provider switching: fake -> scripted-failing -> fake with typed failure + recovery

checks.detail: the planned sequence healthy->scripted-failing->healthy executed (fake -> scripted-failing -> fake)

the scripted-failing lane surfaced the TYPED provider failure PROVIDER_OVERLOADED (retryable=true, retryClass=short-backoff, httpStatus=500) after 3 bounded-retry attempt(s): dogfood scripted provider failure: this lane is armed to fail (the typed PROVIDER_OVERLOADED window over the real adapter wire)

the lane was switched back to the healthy provider (fake, switch 3) and the same call type succeeded there; the failing lane stayed disabled in the workspace providers file; recovery measured 20 ms from failure detection

every healthy-lane answer matched the workspace providers file + the routing-decision ledger, and every ask prompt carried the workspace facts (P2-FIX-118 fence-tolerant parse on live lanes; P2-FIX-119 prompt-carried facts)
the switch report is hash-pinned into the evidence ledger (E-000011)

notes: the typed failure classes are the product's real code paths (the adapter's error taxonomy + the product's bounded-retry bound); the failing wire itself is the harness's scripted lane
model intelligence: fixture (the scripted lanes); seams: local-real (providers-file enablement, routing policy, durable decisions, adapter stream, evidence ledger)

P2-FIX-119: both lanes answer from the prompt-carried workspace facts (providers file content + routing-decision tail, embedded at ask time); the fake lane's server-side computation path for this question is retired; the verification stays strict (checked against the real state files)
P2-FIX-118: live-lane answers parse through the fence-tolerant path (strip-fence-then-parse; malformed JSON inside a fence still fails); machine lanes keep the raw-JSON default
